steps.name: mix
steps.note: The yoghurt is mixed or churned with the water until it is smooth and thin, and is served cold.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. 13 Fermented milk products

sources.text: That ayran is yoghurt mixed with chilled water and salt, and that a drinking yoghurt is made thinner by dilution with water and by mixing, from these; neither gives the amounts for ayran.
